metadata.case_name: RAJWINDER SINGH v. MAN HUNG KWAN AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: back sprain / mechanical low back pain with soft tissue/paraspinal muscle involvement
source: Dr Lam Kwong Chin, who was appointed by the 1st defendant then solicitors while he still had legal representation, opined that the plaintiff’s “back sprain” was actually due to his persisting back problems, with caused the onset of pain at that stage.

The medical experts agreed that the plaintiff had “a mechanical low back pain, mainly with tenderness over the left paraspinal muscle”. The pain was mainly with soft tissue/paraspinal sprain muscle involvement. There was no well-defined neurological deficit.
When the plaintiff was examined by the two experts in August 2012, there was no loss of lumbar lordosis and no paraspinal muscle spasm.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

manifestations.description: tenderness over the left paraspinal muscle
no loss of lumbar lordosis and no paraspinal muscle spasm
plaintiff alleged he felt severe pain in his back and heard a cracking sound immediately

treatments_received: consultation with an unregistered bonesetter in Tokwawan near to where he lives
